units.source_text: 弁君等低声说道：“这样一来，对双方都很不利！”

en.t: Ben no Kimi and the others said in low voices, “If things turn out like this, it will be very bad for both sides!”

units.source_text: 大女公子也想：“究竟怎么一回事啊？

en.t: The elder princess also thought, “What on earth is going on?

units.source_text: 如果他不爱妹妹，怎么办呢？”

en.t: What should we do if he does not love my younger sister?”

units.source_text: 她很担心，不胜痛苦，讨厌这些侍女全不理解主人心情而自作聪明。

en.t: She was deeply worried and unbearably distressed, and she disliked how these ladies-in-waiting understood nothing of their mistress’s feelings yet acted as if they knew best.

units.source_text: 正在左思右想之时，薰君派人送信来了。

en.t: Just as she was turning it over anxiously in her mind, Lord Kaoru sent someone with a letter.

units.source_text: 此次收到他的来信，比往日更加欢喜，却也奇怪。

en.t: Receiving his letter this time made her even happier than usual, yet it also seemed strange.

units.source_text: 但见那信束在一枝枫叶上。

en.t: She saw that the letter was tied to a branch of maple leaves.

units.source_text: 这枝枫叶一半青色，还不知秋光已到，另一半却已变得深红了。

en.t: Half of the maple leaves were still green, as if unaware that autumn had arrived, while the other half had already turned a deep red.
In the letter, there was a poem that read:
